amsterdam.name: Amsterdam
amsterdam.interpretation: The lowest Gini values among the four case studies indicate the most even EV charging distribution in both population and area based assessments.

milan.name: Milan
milan.interpretation: Milan shows moderate inequality in both population and area based coverage, while performing better than Naples and Palermo in the study.

naples.name: Naples
naples.interpretation: Naples has the highest Gini values in the comparison, indicating the strongest spatial inequality in both assessment scenarios.

palermo.name: Palermo
palermo.interpretation: Palermo shows substantial inequality in both population and area based coverage, between Milan and Naples in the four city comparison.
